news.headline: AMD Shares Decline Following New Export Restrictions on AI Chips
news.summary: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. shares fell 5.58% on November 17, 2026, following the implementation of new export restrictions on advanced AI chips to Southeast Asian countries.

news.headline: AMD-Powered Lux Supercomputer Opens to Scientific Users
news.summary: The Lux supercomputer at Oak Ridge National Laboratory, powered by AMD technology, is now available for scientific research as part of the DOE's Genesis Mission.

news.headline: Graid Technology Announces VROC Support for AMD EPYC Platforms
news.summary: Graid Technology plans to extend its CPU-based NVMe RAID solution to AMD EPYC processor-based systems, with initial support launching in February 2027.

news.headline: Situational Awareness Fund Liquidates Micron Technology Stake
news.summary: The investment fund Situational Awareness has completely exited its position in Micron Technology, according to recent regulatory filings.

news.headline: Micron, Samsung, and SK Hynix Fail to Dismiss DRAM Price-Fixing Lawsuit
news.summary: A court has denied a motion by Micron Technology, Samsung, and SK Hynix to dismiss a lawsuit alleging price-fixing in the DRAM market.

news.headline: NVIDIA Issues Warning to Chip Buyers Regarding US Export Compliance
news.summary: NVIDIA has cautioned customers about potential US legal risks associated with providing remote access to advanced chips for Chinese firms.

news.headline: NVIDIA Establishes National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee
news.summary: NVIDIA has formed a new board-level committee to oversee national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risk management.

news.headline: NVIDIA Announces Quantum Computing Collaborations with IBM and Fermilab
news.summary: NVIDIA is partnering with IBM and the Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory to advance quantum computing research, including a new modular codesign platform and a high-speed decoding algorithm.
